# Brand artwork notice

The files in this folder (mascot, application icon, favicon, symbol) are the project's brand artwork, copied from
`docs/brand/assets/` of the Theo workspace. They were generated by the project owner with an AI image tool from their own
prompts, contain no third-party material, and were then traced into vectors.

- They are **not** under the MIT licence of the code. They are licensed under
  [Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 (CC BY 4.0)](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/): you may reuse and adapt them
  if you credit "Theo by ElMaxter99" and say what you changed.
- The name "Theo" is not a registered trademark. Please do not use the artwork in a way that suggests your project is the
  official Theo.
- No warranty. The ownership and registrability of AI-generated images is legally uncertain, so this grant covers whatever
  rights the owner has.
- The artwork can be replaced: the interface references it only through `<img src="brand/...">`, so swapping a file with the
  same name (or editing the paths in `web/src/brand.ts`) is enough.
